# GulfCalc

> Precision statutory and financial calculation suite for the 6 GCC member states: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, and Bahrain. High-precision client-side architecture with zero PII logging and pure mathematical determination.

GulfCalc provides unmetered, mathematically verified financial, tax, and labor law calculation engines for expatriates, corporate counsel, payroll administrators, and HR leaders across the Gulf Cooperation Council.

## Statutory & Financial Calculators

- [Kuwait Indemnity Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-indemnity-calculator.html): Private sector end-of-service indemnity computed using the mandatory 26 working days divisor and 18-month maximum cap under Kuwait Labour Law No. 6/2010 Article 55.
- [Saudi End of Service Award Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-end-of-service-calculator.html): Actual wage basis (basic salary plus housing and transport) severance and tiered resignation deductions under Saudi Labour Law Royal Decree No. M/51 Articles 84, 85, and 87.
- [UAE End of Service Gratuity Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-gratuity-calculator.html): Basic wage gratuity accrual (21 days for years 1-5, 30 days thereafter, capped at 2 years) with unified limited contract parity under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33/2021 Article 51.
- [Qatar End of Service Gratuity Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/qatar-gratuity-calculator.html): Minimum 3 weeks (21 calendar days) basic wage per completed year of service with exact pro-rata fractional tenure under Qatar Labour Law No. 14/2004 Article 54.
- [Oman End of Service Gratuity Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/oman-gratuity-calculator.html): Modern flat 30 days per year basic wage accrual under Oman Labour Law Royal Decree No. 53/2023 Article 61, with legacy pre-July 2023 dual-scale engine under repealed RD 35/2003.
- [Bahrain End of Service Indemnity & VAT Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/bahrain-eosi-calculator.html): Terminal severance under Bahrain Labour Law No. 36/2012 Article 116, 2024 SIO expat fund deposit reform under Decision No. 109/2023, and integrated 10% standard VAT engine.
- [UAE Corporate Tax Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-corporate-tax-calculator.html): Statutory 9% corporate tax computation with zero percent threshold up to AED 375,000 and Small Business Relief (SBR) election up to AED 3,000,000 under Federal Decree-Law No. 47/2022.
- [Saudi Dependent Fee & Iqama Renewal Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-dependent-fee-calculator.html): Computes statutory SAR 400 per month dependent fee, Jawazat residency renewals (SAR 650), and Maktab Amal work permit levies across 3, 6, 9, and 12-month renewal cycles.
- [UAE Visa Overstay Fine Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-overstay-fine-calculator.html): Unified ICP and GDRFA flat 50 AED per day overstay penalty engine across visit, tourist, and cancelled residency visas with grace period and exit permit calculations.
- [UAE Emiratisation Penalty & MoHRE NAFIS Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-emiratisation-penalty-calculator.html): MoHRE statutory quota deficit fines (AED 6,000 to AED 8,000 per month per unhired UAE national) for private companies with 20-49 and 50+ staff under Cabinet Resolution No. (19/M) of 2022.
- [Dubai RERA Rent Increase Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/dubai-rera-rent-calculator.html): Evaluates statutory legal rent hike caps (0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%) based on official RERA Rental Index gap benchmarks under Dubai Decree No. 43 of 2013.
- [Saudi GOSI Social Insurance Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/saudi-gosi-calculator.html): Social insurance contributions covering 9.75% Annuity and 0.75% SANED for Saudi citizens, and 2% Occupational Hazard contribution for expatriates under Royal Decree No. M/22.
- [Kuwait Family Visa Eligibility & Cost Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-family-visa-calculator.html): Verifies the mandatory KWD 800 salary threshold, university degree criteria, Dhaman health insurance fees (50 KWD/yr), and PACI Civil ID charges under Ministerial Decision No. 56/2024.
- [GCC Remittance Fee & FX Spread Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-remittance-fee-calculator.html): True cross-border financial friction comparator calculating hidden exchange rate markups and upfront wire fees across regional banking and exchange house corridors.
- [GCC Cost of Living & Purchasing Power Comparator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/gcc-cost-of-living-comparator.html): 8-city expat living cost, residential rent, international schooling, utility tariffs, and VAT parity index across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah, Doha, Kuwait City, Muscat, and Manama.
- [Kuwait PIFSS Net Take-Home Salary Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/kuwait-pifss-net-salary-calculator.html): Computes 10.5% PIFSS social security pension deductions for Kuwaiti citizens up to 3,000 KWD ceiling, and models zero percent tax retention for expatriates.
- [UAE Real Estate Golden Visa Property Calculator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/uae-golden-visa-property-calculator.html): Models the AED 2,000,000 property investment threshold, 4% Dubai Land Department fees, mortgage equity compliance, and net rental yields under Cabinet Resolution No. 65/2022.
- [AI GCC Contract Clause Compliance Checker](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/ai-contract-clause-checker.html): Interactive client-side legal evaluator checking employment contract clauses against UAE Decree-Law 33/2021 and Saudi Royal Decree M/51 to identify void terms and draft counter-proposals.
- [AI GCC Statutory Resignation Letter Generator](https://gulfcalc.tech/tools/ai-resignation-letter-generator.html): Form-driven legal resignation drafter citing statutory labor notice articles to preserve end-of-service gratuity and terminal benefit rights.

## Arabic Localization & RTL Bilingual Suite (النسخة العربية)

- [مركز الأبحاث والتحليلات القانونية والمالية (النسخة العربية)](https://gulfcalc.tech/ar/blog/index.html): البوابة المركزية باللغة العربية للأدلة القانونية والتحليلات التشريعية المعتمدة لقوانين العمل والضرائب الخليجية.
- [دليل حساب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة في البحرين وقواعد التأمينات للوافدين](https://gulfcalc.tech/ar/blog/how-to-calculate-indemnity-in-bahrain.html): دليل شامل باللغة العربية لاحتساب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة وفق المادة 116 من قانون العمل البحريني رقم 36 لسنة 2012، وضوابط سداد اشتراكات التأمينات الاجتماعية (SIO) للوافدين.
- [بوابة الحسابات المالية وقوانين العمل لدول الخليج](https://gulfcalc.tech/ar/index.html): البوابة المركزية باللغة العربية لحاسبات مكافأة نهاية الخدمة، الضرائب، ومستحقات العمالة في دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي مع مصفوفة مقارنة عمالية شاملة.
- [حاسبة مكافأة نهاية الخدمة في الإمارات](https://gulfcalc.tech/ar/tools/uae-gratuity.html): احتساب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة وفق المادة 51 من المرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم 33 لسنة 2021 (21 يوماً أساسياً عن السنوات الخمس الأولى، و30 يوماً عما زاد، بحد أقصى أجر سنتين، مع توحيد حقوق الاستقالة والإنهاء بنسبة 100%).
- [حاسبة مكافأة نهاية الخدمة في السعودية](https://gulfcalc.tech/ar/tools/saudi-eos.html): احتساب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة وفق نظام العمل السعودي الصادر بالمرسوم الملكي م/51 (المادتين 84 و85) على أساس الأجر الفعلي الكامل (الأساسي + بدلات السكن والنقل الثابتة) بواقع نصف شهر عن أول 5 سنوات وشهر كامل تالياً، وتطبيق جدول استقطاعات الاستقالة الطوعية.

- [GCC Financial & Legal Blog Hub](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/index.html): Central repository of peer-reviewed statutory commentary, tax compliance guides, and judicial analyses.

## Analytical Guides & Legal Intelligence

- [UAE Visa Amnesty: Overstay Fine Waiver, ICP Exit Pass Rules, and Status Regularization](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-visa-amnesty-overstay-fine-waiver-rules.html): Operational guide to ICP and GDRFA grace periods waiving 50 AED/day overstay fines, exit permit issuance within 14 days, and employment transfers without re-entry bans.
- [How to Calculate Indemnity in Bahrain: SIO Expat Rules, Article 116 Formula, and Resignation Guidelines](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/how-to-calculate-indemnity-in-bahrain.html): Comprehensive statutory guide to Bahrain Labour Law No. 36/2012 Article 116, the 15-day and 30-day salary tiers, and the recent SIO expatriate end-of-service accrual reforms.
- [UAE Gratuity Calculation on Limited Contract 2026](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-gratuity-calculation-limited-contract-2026.html): Complete legal review of Federal Decree-Law No. 33/2021 Article 51 and the abolition of resignation penalty tiers.
- [Saudi Labor Law Amendments: Notice Period, Gratuity & Probation](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/saudi-labor-law-amendments-notice-period-gratuity.html): Authoritative guide on Royal Decree No. M/51 amendments establishing 30-day employee resignation notice, 60-day employer termination notice, 180-day probation terms, and actual wage end-of-service awards.
- [Saudi Labor Law Articles 84 and 85 Resignation Rules](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/saudi-labor-law-article-84-85-resignation-rules.html): Statutory analysis of actual wage definitions, tiered resignation scales, and Article 87 exceptions under Royal Decree M/51.
- [Kuwait Labour Law Article 55 and the 26 Working Days Rule](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/kuwait-labor-law-article-55-26-days-calculation.html): Judicial and statutory examination of why dividing monthly compensation by 30 days violates Kuwaiti labor standards.
- [Oman New Labour Law Royal Decree 53/2023 Gratuity](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/oman-new-labor-law-royal-decree-53-2023-gratuity.html): In-depth review of the shift to 30 days flat per year and transition mechanics from legacy Royal Decree 35/2003.
- [UAE Corporate Tax Small Business Relief Guide](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/uae-corporate-tax-small-business-relief-guide.html): Compliance guide to Ministerial Decision No. 73/2023 and the AED 3,000,000 revenue relief threshold.
- [Qatar End of Service Benefits and Overtime Wage Rules](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/qatar-end-of-service-benefits-overtime-wages.html): Analysis of basic wage calculation bases and statutory severance obligations under Law No. 14/2004 Article 54.
- [Bahrain SIO Expatriate End of Service Reform](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/bahrain-sio-expat-end-of-service-reform.html): Examination of Decision No. 109/2023 and the centralization of non-Bahraini indemnity deposits into the Social Insurance Organisation.
- [GCC VAT Reverse Charge Mechanism for Cross-Border Services](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/gcc-vat-reverse-charge-mechanism-cross-border-services.html): Guide to cross-border B2B digital procurement and tax compliance under the GCC Unified VAT Framework.
- [Dubai Golden Visa Real Estate and Salary Thresholds](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/dubai-golden-visa-real-estate-salary-thresholds.html): Statutory criteria for AED 2M real estate and AED 30,000 monthly executive employment 10-year residency pathways.
- [DEWS vs Traditional Cash Gratuity in the UAE](https://gulfcalc.tech/blog/dews-vs-traditional-cash-gratuity-uae-workplace-savings.html): Comparative analysis of defined-contribution workplace savings funds versus traditional defined-benefit cash payouts.
